content.text: As a digital creator in a restricted country, you're likely fed up with Stripe and PayPal's arbitrary freezes, account closures, and extortionate fees. You know the pain of being forced to rely on unreliable platforms that hold your funds hostage. Take, for example, the case of Zimbabwean creators who faced crippling financial isolation due to PayPal's restrictions. This is not just a problem for Zimbabweans; it's a global issue that affects digital creators in countries like Venezuela, Nigeria, and Ghana. The question is, what sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-5|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto|infrastructure]] solution can save you from this mess and give you the freedom to own your store, your data, and your income?

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-5. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

COREMERCH's Sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-complete-2|COREMERCH guide to start]]er Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are two distinct solutions designed to meet the unique needs of digital creators. The Sovereign Starter Stack, for instance, comes with GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, giving you a basic yet robust digital commerce infrastructure. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack adds advanced features like Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, providing a more comprehensive solution for creators who need high-performance and scalability. Both stacks are free to deploy and come with 30-day support from COREMERCH's team of experts.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both COREMERCH solutions are designed to bypass the limitations of platforms like Stripe and PayPal, which often have country-specific restrictions. With COREMERCH, you can deploy your digital commerce infrastructure in any country, without the risk of account closures or freezes. This is made possible by the use of free and open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, which allow you to host your store and manage your data independently.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments, the payment gateway used by COREMERCH, offers lightning-fast payment processing with fees as low as 0.5%. This is significantly cheaper than the fees charged by Stripe and PayPal, which can range from 2.9% to 5%. Additionally, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving you the flexibility to accept payments in any cryptocurrency you choose. The real cost savings come from the ability to avoid the high transaction fees charged by traditional payment processors.
COREMERCH solutions are designed to be free and open-source, giving you complete control over your digital commerce infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With COREMERCH, you own your digital commerce infrastructure from day one. This means you have complete control over your store, your data, and your income. You can automate tasks like order fulfillment and delivery using Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, ensuring a seamless customer experience. Your files and product delivery are handled by Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, giving you secure and reliable storage options.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The practical steps to infrastructure sovereignty start with choosing where your data lives. In Stack 01, orders are stored in Google Sheets — your Google account, your data, exportable at any time. In Stack 02, orders are stored in Supabase — your Supabase account, PostgreSQL database, full SQL access, exportable at any time. Product files in Stack 01 live in Google Drive — your Google account, 15GB free, shared via time-limited links generated by Apps Script. In Stack 02, files live in Cloudflare R2 — your Cloudflare account, 10GB free, zero egress fees, presigned URLs with configurable expiry.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

The most important question a reader would ask is, 'Which COREMERCH solution is right for me?' The answer is, it depends on your digital commerce needs. If you're just starting out, the Sovereign Starter Stack is an excellent choice. If you need advanced features and high-performance, the Edge Commerce Stack is the way to go. Both stacks are designed to be scalable, so you can always upgrade or downgrade as your business grows.
With NOWPayments, you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, reducing transaction fees and increasing your revenue.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from COREMERCH. This instant download includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, giving you everything you need to create a robust and scalable digital commerce infrastructure. Alternatively, you can shop for COREMERCH products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. With COREMERCH, you can say goodbye to Stripe and PayPal's limitations and hello to a sovereign digital commerce future.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a COREMERCH solution, follow these steps: Purchase the COREMERCH product that suits your needs, either the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. Deploy the stack using the provided documentation and support from COREMERCH's team. Configure your NOWPayments account to accept payments in your preferred cryptocurrency. Set up Cloudflare Workers and Supabase to automate tasks like order fulfillment and delivery. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure and reliable file storage and delivery. Test your store to ensure seamless customer experience and fast payment processing.
